title: How To Search For Featured Members In The Database
text:
## How To Search For Featured Members In The Database
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000059855
To see the list of members who have been featured on the homepage via its Quick Edits:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181110861/original/sK6G8RQTt7SM1n9S5wLWtRYncL-71kJsSg.png?1782513284 | alt: ]
Navigate to Developers --> MySQL Database :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181110846/original/Y0J8iOyJlC72aEHUBr9HHnMimkDv77pxDw.png?1782513219 | alt: ]
Click on the database that ends with wording " directory ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054310080/original/GZds3y0AO7IZwRLeisQsslBnliwYTDG0QQ.png?1564179707 | alt: ]
Conduct a search for the table users_data and open it by clicking on it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054310121/original/ALns7iwPau4cAovJzHV03y5cDXGqb6ZF9w.png?1564179814 | alt: ]
Click on SQL :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054310175/original/6cxtfFVz_8loZCJXtQXWS5oWhdQFzJqtIA.png?1564179939 | alt: ]
Paste the specified SQL code and click Go :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054310216/original/uLoWMNZHWhufjokN43RtXGnExKxAIfCw3g.png?1564180039 | alt: ]
